title: Ring-hand gestures round 2
desc: Gestures redone after J called 814 subpar and X4 unclear: boards say what each is for, named cameras, hands placed exactly, first person reframed.

takes.name: Cast
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair: rest knuckles down, ring worn like a bracelet; over 0.4 s (ticks 6-14) the fist turns 100 deg up smoothly, barely moving out; bolt from the knuckles to the crosshair at 14

takes.name: Oath
takes.facts: fist to the heart by 8, drives up 18-23 with overshoot, head lifts 40 deg, light column 22-30, down by 60

takes.name: Focus
takes.facts: ring stops exactly on the brow at 12, head bows 20 deg, eyes light, two breaths, release by 52

takes.name: Put the ring on
takes.facts: ring put on by the left hand 8-16, click 16, power-up 18-22; smooth slide, hands never touch, left hand pulls away in 3 ticks, one soft glow on the ring; a dome of light out to 80 blocks (4 a tick)
takes.cam3p: Cam X4 Put the ring on - third person
takes.camfp: Cam X4 Put the ring on - first person

takes.name: Put the ring on, ground wave
takes.facts: as X4; smooth slide, hands never touch, left hand pulls away in 3 ticks, one soft glow on the ring; a wall of light along the ground out to 80 blocks
takes.cam3p: Cam X4b Put the ring on, ground wave - third person
takes.camfp: Cam X4b Put the ring on, ground wave - first person

takes.name: Put the ring on, double wave
takes.facts: as X4; smooth slide, hands never touch, left hand pulls away in 3 ticks, one soft glow on the ring; two domes of light 6 ticks apart, out to 80 blocks
takes.cam3p: Cam X4c Put the ring on, double wave - third person
takes.camfp: Cam X4c Put the ring on, double wave - first person
